layer.release_boundary: public GitHub documentation and a local read-only evaluator; no automatic live installation
state_or_contract: candidate is accepted only when it improves the chosen metric, preserves every safety assertion, and passes every held-out case

observed.actual: The public configuration explains autoresearch, but supplies no deterministic command that compares a frozen baseline and one candidate on the same task receipts while rejecting held-out or safety regressions.
observed.expected: Users can run one explicit, non-live pilot comparison before adopting a change to an agent skill, prompt, or configuration.

plan.causal_hypothesis: A pure, schema-validating comparison command plus a public guide will make harness improvement reproducible and fail closed, without granting a framework permission to mutate live configuration.
fix_steps: Add the read-only receipt comparator and focused tests.
Document the bounded workflow, schema, acceptance rule, and non-goals for public users.
Link the guide from README and append a public changelog entry.

summary: Add a deterministic, non-live harness-improvement pilot evaluator and public adoption guide.
